name: Latin and Greek word origins

provides.latinNames: Latin name (Terminologia Anatomica style) for the 1,357 English structure labels the zh-Hant pack lists, plus rules for sides (sin., dext.), numbers and qualifiers
provides.origins: Word-origin card in the selection sidebar: roots, prefixes and suffixes with Greek or Latin source, and a plain meaning (hepatic = liver related)
provides.grammar: data/grammar.json holds declensions, plural forms, abbreviations and diminutives for later use; the page does not show it yet
provides.languages: English glosses, and Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) when the zh-Hant pack is on

requires: 3D Anatomy Model page with lang/loader.js and the selection sidebar (explode.js)
